_comment: Rung table for cross-type auto-pivot attribution (tools/selector_types.py rung_for). A shared artifact only becomes an owner-link, a kit fact, or a neighbour observation according to this table — collecting is not attributing. owner = may seed same-operator edges and operator_leads; kit = stored as add_fact only, never an edge/cluster member/operator_lead; neighbour = co-tenancy / exchange flow, collected but never attributed. Unknown classes resolve to kit (conservative). Edit a class here when evidence shows a token is owner-tied or merely template-shared. RULE 1: identifier CLASSES only, never case data.

rungs._comment: identifier class → owner|kit|neighbour. analytics.* (GA/GTM/gtag/FB/TikTok/Metrica) and exact cert / registrant WHOIS / bot-token / discord-webhook / non-exchange wallet are owner. Ad/affiliate IDs, other tokens, html-id, telegram.username, page-scraped contacts, bank account, username/string/filename/hash/title/favicon/tx_id are kit. Exchange wallets and IP co-tenants are neighbour. ads.* with no more-specific entry is treated as kit by rung_for. ads.payee (the legal payee name/domain Google's sellers.json names for an AdSense pub id — wp_sellers / sellers_lookup) is owner: the pub id is kit, the entity paid for its impressions is not. app.developer_url (a store listing's developer website whose registrable domain equals a case domain — wp_appdev / app_developer) and app.apple_team (the 10-char Apple Developer team ID in a Mach-O signing identity — BinaryPivot) are owner.

fact_only_node_classes._comment: Route → rung classes that are stored as KB facts on the origin page and NEVER registered as typed nodes in state.json (so propose() never pivots on them). A Quarry page export lists every contact the page scraped — a directory page yields hundreds of strangers' phones/emails. The "*" row applies to EVERY route: a token contract (wallet.token_contract — USDT-TRC20 and the like, WebPivot/references/crypto_reference_addresses.json) is a public constant, so a node on it would balance-look-up and pivot on every site that accepts the token. Owner classes (whois.registrant_*) on the same route are unaffected. Fallback in code: {quarry.page: [page.email, page.phone], *: [wallet.token_contract]}.

caveats._comment: Per-class caveats that travel with an owner link whose strength cannot be fully measured. Informational — rung_for never reads this group; it is the analyst-facing note for the class.

entries.whois.privacy_customer: Privacy-service customer id ('Contact Privacy Inc. Customer <digits>'). Owner-link candidate when two domains share one id, but its population CANNOT be measured: reverse-WHOIS tokenises the term and returns every domain behind the same privacy proxy, so never reverse it and never read a missing count as rarity.
entries.txt.verification: Site/mail verification token from an apex TXT record. Owner only after the collector checked the provider's own zone and the token is absent there; a token found in the provider zone is a provider-wide constant (never emitted), and an unchecked token is ingested as a lead fact, not an edge.
